title: Malaysia & Singapore, from the Malay and Chinese press

stories.text: Fares on the ECRL rail line from Gombak to Kota Bharu will start at RM125, or RM147 for the express service.
Singapore's National Wages Council recommended raising low-wage workers' pay by at least $120.
Anwar said 1MDB's debt is not yet fully paid, and new borrowing will be based on need.
Shanmugam said Singapore will use every legal and regulatory measure against companies that cause haze.
In the Negeri Sembilan crisis, Ahmad Zahid told the state's 18 BN assemblymen not to interfere in matters of the royal institution.
Dr Akmal was ordered to pay RM250,000 in damages to Teresa Kok in her defamation suit.
Papagomo was acquitted of sedition, and the Attorney-General's Chambers will appeal.
The ringgit weakened to RM4.08 against the US dollar but strengthened against other major currencies.
Bursa Malaysia fell below 1,600 points, with Public Bank down 12 sen.
stories.source: Sin Chew Daily 星洲日报

stories.text: Singapore's Prime Minister met Qatar's Prime Minister to discuss deeper cooperation on energy and AI.
Thirteen men were remanded over molotov cocktails thrown at a Rohingya settlement.
Cloud seeding operations are being carried out in four states, Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya.
From 1 November, express bus tickets will be sold only at APAD-licensed terminals.
A court ordered the government to return 176 Bitcoin to nine victims of the Bitkingdom scam.
In Singapore, 3,000 tertiary students will get a year of industry training in response to the impact of AI.
